source.latest_patch_selection: max(patch) <=10 independently per creature_id and creature_template entry; spawns require patch_min<=10<=patch_max

rules.positive_kill_award: base * (1 + (general_rep_aura_percent + faction_kill_aura_percent)/100) * (mob_level<=gray_level ? lowlevel_kill_rate : 1) * faction_creature_rate * global_rate; then rand_dither; then truncate_towards_zero(after * supplied_party_rate)
rules.negative_kill_award: base * faction_creature_rate * global_rate; rand_dither; supplied party rate then truncation; no gray or Diplomacy adjustment
rules.random_rounding: rand_dither preserves sign; rounds abs(v) down/up with up probability equal to fractional magnitude. Fractional expected-value simulation is an estimate; it does not guarantee each kill gives that fraction.
rules.cap_check: rank of this slot faction before its award <= MaxStanding. Full award then applies; clamp only to global range. No exact clipping to next-rank threshold. Slots execute in order1 then2.
rules.ordinary_spillover: Only when the primary slot passes its rank gate. For each DB template effect, compare recipient current rank<=rank_i; truncate signed primary integer_delta*rate_i toward zero; update recipient directly without recursive spillover or reapplying bonuses; then update primary itself.
rules.is_team_award: After the primary rank-gated call, outside that cap check, if IsTeamAward and parent known, give parent integer(primary_calculated_delta/2) with noSpillover=true. Thus do not implement it as recursive town spillover. Parent data here is separately labeled Classic client metadata.
rules.team_dependent: If true, slot1 is Alliance-only and slot2 is Horde-only; otherwise process both signed slots.

diplomacy.forever_assumption: Do not infer Human Diplomacy is present in Forever; apply only an explicit known/configured active reputation bonus. Forever changed Human racials.

rules.coverage_limit: No positive direct kill award for 67,68,76,81,530,2587 appears in this selected snapshot catalog. Outdoor AD normal mobs here have low caps; elites/dungeon sources remain disabled. No all-ten Exalted feasibility claim.
